hypotheses.G0_native_model_generalizes_both_directi: The full model shifts the old target vocabulary from new cues and the new target vocabulary from old cues correctly in at least 75% of examples in every split.
hypotheses.G1_L8H2_cue_edge_generalizes_both_direct: The finite L8H2 cue-edge intervention shifts each cross-vocabulary contrast correctly in at least 65% of examples in every split.
hypotheses.G2_L9H8_mediation_generalizes: Freezing L9H8's boundary edge removes at least 40% of that finite upstream effect in every split and direction.
hypotheses.G3_route_specificity_generalizes: The predicted upstream effect exceeds both upstream controls by 5x, and its L9H8 mediation exceeds both downstream controls by 0.20, in every split and direction.
hypotheses.G4_declared_contrasts_beat_random: The upstream and mediated effects exceed the 95th percentile of balanced random contrasts in every split and direction.
